00011122233310213203012 - ASI: 21

Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  01 = 0 * 1
  10 = 1 * 0
  12 = 1 * 2
  13 = 1 * 3
  20 = 2 * 0
  22 = 2 * 2
  30 = 3 * 0
  33 = 3 * 3
  112 = 1 * 12
  213 = 2 * 13
  0001 = 00 * 01
  2233 = 22 * 33
  3012 = 30 * 12
  10213 = 10 * 213
  203012 = 20 * 3012
  310213 = 3 * 10213
  1122233 = 112 * 2233
  00011122233 = 0001 * 1122233
  310213203012 = 310213 * 203012
  00011122233310213203012 = 00011122233 * 310213203012
